import: import { List, ListItem, ListBox, ToggleListItem } from "@zen-ds/react";

components.name: List
components.description:
A plain list of List-Items (ul, no bullets). Rows are spaced Spacing/Gap/3XSmall (2px), static and clickable alike
 (Figma List-Box Body-Slot); each row pads itself 12px above and below. The container insets the list sideways
 (ListBox does): leave at least Padding/Small (12px) at the sides of clickable rows for the fill.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root `<ul>`.

props.name: inset
props.deprecated:
Rows keep the spacing Figma sets inside List-Item: Padding/Small (12px) above and below, none at the
 sides; the container around the List insets it sideways. This prop still gives the rows a horizontal padding
 (comfortable = Margin/Comfortable, compact = Margin/Compact, none = 0) for existing apps.

components.name: ListItem
components.description:
Figma List-Item (4080:11700): a Wrapper row (gap Medium) of Leading · Contents · Trailing, padded Spacing/Padding/Small
(12px) above and below and nothing at the sides (one set for every device; Contents = Info-Content, Title and
Subtitle Spacing/Gap/3XSmall apart).
- Interactive=Yes (onClick or href): an Interactive-Background Padding/Small (12px) outside the content on every side —
  the row's height, 12px past it sideways (Interactive-List-Item-Radius: Corner-Radius/Base 12px on desktop, Large 16px
  on tablet and mobile) — that shows Neutral/Flat Hover · Pressed and Active/Neutral/Subtle when selected; the
  container leaves at least 12px at the row's sides.
- Interactive=No (neither): no background or states.
- Value (`value`, `valueCaption`): a right-aligned Info-Content after the title stack, Body/Base/Bold over
  Body/Small/Regular Content/Neutral/Light, Spacing/Gap/3XSmall apart, tabular figures; it keeps its width and the title
  truncates (a transaction or a total per row).
Never add padding to the row: the layout around the List decides where it sits.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root row element.

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Info-Content Title (Body/Base/Bold, Content/Neutral/Strongest).

props.name: titleLines
props.description:
Lines the title may take before it truncates with an ellipsis. 1 (default) = Figma's one line
 (Title, textTruncation ENDING, maxLines 1); 2 when the title must be read in full, e.g. a long task or document name
 in a narrow list.

props.name: caption
props.description: Figma Info-Content Subtitle (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Light).

props.name: leading
props.description: Figma Leading slot: an Avatar (Image-Size/Medium), Dock Icon, thumbnail or an icon name (`"icon-clock-line"`).

props.name: value
props.description:
A value at the row's end, read with the title: an amount, a total, a count ("+94,860,000 VND", "92 h"). Body/Base/Bold
 like the title, right-aligned and never cut: the title truncates first. With `valueCaption` it is a second
 Info-Content mirrored to the right (code-only; in Figma, a text stack in the Trailing slot). It is part of the row's
 button or link, so a clickable row reads it out.

props.name: valueCaption
props.description:
The line under `value` (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Light), level with the caption: the amount in another
 currency, a date, a unit ("3,600.00 USD").

props.name: valueTone
props.description:
Colour of `value`, a Color/Content tone as Text's `tone`: "strongest" (default, like the title); "positive-light" /
 "negative-light" for a signed amount or delta that must stand out (money in, a drop). Keep the sign in the text too:
 the colour never carries the meaning alone.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Figma Trailing slot (Slot-Actions): Medium (md) buttons / icon buttons, a Badge or a chevron. It follows `value`.

props.name: children
props.description: Figma Contents slot override: replaces the title/caption stack.

props.name: selected
props.description:
Figma State=Selected (Background/Active/Neutral/Subtle). Interactive rows only (Figma has no Selected for
 Interactive=No): pair it with onClick or href.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Makes the row one action: Figma Interactive=Yes (an Interactive-Background over the row's height and 12px past it
 sideways, Interactive-List-Item-Radius corners, Hover / Pressed from real interaction). Without onClick or href the row is Interactive=No: no background or states. Keep
 trailing buttons out of clickable rows.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders the row as a link (Figma Interactive=Yes).

props.name: as
props.description: "li" (default, inside <List>) or "div" when used on its own.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the icon the row draws for an icon-name `leading`, by layer (`{ Leading: { name:
 "icon-heart-line" } }`). Written by Zen Studio; app code sets `leading`. Slot content (an Avatar you pass) is edited
 as itself.

components.name: ListBox
components.description:
Figma Component/List-Box (14922:75297): the white box that holds a list of rows, the same on every device — only the
tokens change by mode. Surface/Default, Corner-Radius/2XLarge (24px, concentric with the row fill:
Interactive-List-Item-Radius + its gap to the edge), Header-Slot · Body-Slot · Footer-Slot padded Card-padding-medium
sideways (24px desktop · 20px tablet and mobile), the body List-Container-Vertical-Padding above and below. Header and
Footer are optional (Figma Header=No / Footer=No). `theme` is Figma's Theme: default, shadow, pale, border,
flat-border or on-container.

props.name: width
props.description:
Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width.
`"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches.
`"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding
and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full
width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap.
A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box).
(Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.)
Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame).

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width in px (Figma min width). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width in px (Figma max width), e.g. a readable line length for a Fill block of text.

props.name: alignSelf
props.description:
This element's alignment inside its parent: start · center · end · stretch across a Stack's
direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align`
for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth
stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root element.

props.name: header
props.description:
Figma Header-Slot (Header=Yes): what names the box, e.g. a Heading/Subheading title and a caption, or a toolbar.
 Pads Card-padding-medium on top and at the sides and Padding/XSmall below; its content stacks Spacing/Gap/Medium.

props.name: children
props.description:
Figma Body-Slot: the rows, usually a `<List>` of ListItems. Pads Card-padding-medium sideways and
 List-Container-Vertical-Padding above and below (12px desktop, 8px tablet and mobile) and stacks its children
 Spacing/Gap/3XSmall, so a clickable row's fill sits 12px (desktop) or 8px (phone) from every box edge.

props.name: footer
props.description: Figma Footer-Slot (Footer=Yes): what follows the rows, e.g. a "Show all" Tertiary button. Pads Card-padding-medium.

props.name: theme
props.description:
Elevation, Figma Theme (the tokens of Card's Theme). Default: Surface/Default alone — on Canvas/Default it
 needs no frame (usage rules §16). Shadow: Shadow/Bottom/Level-1, when the page's elevation follows a default Sidebar. Pale:
 Support/Neutral/Pale + Effect/Overlay blur, a tinted box (never with a shadow, §9). Border: a 1px
 Border/Neutral/Pale ring inside, for a white page (Canvas/Alt, a phone screen) or a box inside another Surface (§11).
 Flat-Border: Surface/Flat inside that ring, the box of a Canvas/Flat page (Figma Theme=Flat-Border, 15531:3660).
 On-Container: Surface/Flat, a box inside a Modal, Side Panel or Bottom Sheet (their Container fill, §16).

props.name: as
props.description: "div" (default) or "section" when the box is a titled region (give it aria-labelledby).

components.name: ToggleListItem
components.description:
A settings row whose whole surface is one switch: a ListItem (leading, Title, Caption) with a Toggle-Button
(Toggle/Toggle-Button) in its trailing slot. Composed from the Figma List-Item and Toggle-Button primitives with
their own tokens — no Figma master of its own yet (backlog batch 6, user 2026-10-07). A press anywhere on the row
flips the switch (the row is a <label> around it); the switch keeps the focus ring and Space / Enter (APG Switch).

props.name: ref
props.description: The root row element.

props.name: title
props.description: What the switch turns on or off (Body/Base/Bold, one line); it names the switch.

props.name: caption
props.description: One line under the title (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base): what the setting does. It describes the switch.

props.name: leading
props.description: Icon name or element before the text, as in ListItem.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled on/off state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state on a press anywhere on the row, or Space / Enter on the switch.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The row and its switch do nothing; the switch shows Disabled.

props.name: toggleSize
props.description: Toggle-Button size. Default md.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name of the switch's checkbox (submitted as "on" while checked).

props.name: as
props.description: Root element. Default `li` (inside a List); `div` outside one.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the switch and icon it draws, by layer (`{ "Toggle-Button": { size: "sm" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets toggleSize / leading.
